false_positives_documented.reason: The CLI treats any string as a valid hashtag query; Naver's search returns matching posts regardless. The CLI is correct; the runner cannot know that hashtag commands accept any string.
The runner does not pre-create the placeholder file. The CLI correctly errors when the file is missing. Real users always pass a real file.
The CLI returns an empty array + a friendly hint when the local cache has no matching rows. The runner expected non-zero exit; empty-results-is-not-an-error is correct UX for FTS commands.
